measurements.label: phone-B

checks_not_made: freshness: the expected challenge is taken from the record itself, so the challenge check shows only that the leaf certificate carries the challenge the record names
the day itself: verified_as_of is the day the status list is said to be fetched, and on that day its age is 0 every time, so the age of the list is not judged
anything after that day: a later revocation, a later unlock of the device, whether the key still exists
a kept key under this alias, without user binding: read from the record's own fields, not from the certificate
that the key belongs to the device the AE-ID names: AE-ID and label are given by whoever enrols
which app holds the key: the app identity in the certificate is not compared with anything
that the key was made in the secure hardware and not imported: the origin in the certificate is not judged

not_shown: who holds the phone: the key used has no binding to a fingerprint or a screen lock
an authenticated originator: the lab CSEs take the X-M2M-Origin header as given, so the registry's access policy and the 'target' role bind honest parties only
a fresh attestation: the key was attested on the day of the record; its certificate chain is checked as of that day
the full handover: admission here lets the AE be created on the target; the data move is phone/estimed_poc2.py, which does not call this yet
that the app that signs is the app that was attested, beyond holding the key

steps.step: the IN-CSE and both edges answer
the attestation record verifies as of the day it was made, shows a hardware-backed key on a locked device that booted verified, and names a kept key without user binding
steps.detail: alias witness-20261015, PASS, as of 2026-10-15T10:22:47+00:00 (day taken from: filename), attestation level TrustedEnvironment, key level TrustedEnvironment

steps.step: the registry holds the key and the target edge reads it back unchanged
CONTROL (must FAIL) a stranger wrote a key into the registry
a handover transaction is open at the IN-CSE and the target read its identifier and valid-until
without a signature the target does not admit, and the phone's AE is not on the target
steps.detail: no signature was presented; AE on B HTTP 404

steps.step: the phone's serial is given in $RSU_SERIAL
the phone signed the transaction's digest with its kept key (probe mode sign, no prompt)
CONTROL (must FAIL) a signature by another key of the same phone over the right digest was admitted
steps.detail: the signature does not verify with the enrolled key over this transaction

steps.step: with the phone's signature over this transaction the target admits, and only then is the AE created on the target
steps.detail: admitted; AE on B created: True

steps.step: CONTROL (must FAIL) the same signature shown a second time was admitted
CONTROL (must FAIL) a transaction past its valid-until was admitted
steps.detail: the transaction is past its valid-until

steps.step: CONTROL (must FAIL) an AE-ID the registry does not know was admitted
steps.detail: the registry holds no key for this AE-ID

steps.step: CONTROL (must FAIL) a handover onto the source was admitted
a second transaction can be opened after the first is closed
CONTROL (must FAIL) the signature made for the first transaction was admitted for a second one
steps.detail: the signature does not verify with the enrolled key over this transaction

steps.step: nothing is left behind: registry, transaction and the AE on the target are gone
